Basic Cache Operations (CRUD)

1. Getting a Cache Reference
  • // Get existing cache (returns null if not found)
IgniteCache<Integer, String> cache = ignite.cache("myCache");

// Get or create (creates with default config if not found)
IgniteCache<Integer, String> cache = ignite.getOrCreateCache("myCache");

// Get or create with specific configuration
CacheConfiguration<Integer, String> cfg = new CacheConfiguration<>("myCache");
cfg.setBackups(1);
IgniteCache<Integer, String> cache = ignite.getOrCreateCache(cfg);
2. Put (Create / Update)
  • // Put a single entry (overwrites if exists)
cache.put(1, "Alice");

// Put only if absent (returns true if inserted)
boolean inserted = cache.putIfAbsent(2, "Bob");

// Put multiple entries at once
Map<Integer, String> entries = new HashMap<>();
entries.put(3, "Charlie");
entries.put(4, "Diana");
cache.putAll(entries);

// Put and return the old value
String oldValue = cache.getAndPut(1, "Alice Updated");
3. Get (Read)
  • // Get a single entry
String value = cache.get(1);

// Get multiple entries
Set<Integer> keys = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(1, 2, 3));
Map<Integer, String> results = cache.getAll(keys);

// Check if a key exists
boolean exists = cache.containsKey(1);
4. Remove (Delete)
  • // Remove by key
boolean removed = cache.remove(1);

// Remove only if value matches
boolean removed = cache.remove(1, "Alice");

// Remove and return old value
String oldValue = cache.getAndRemove(1);

// Remove multiple keys
Set<Integer> keys = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(1, 2, 3));
cache.removeAll(keys);

// Remove all entries
cache.removeAll();
5. Replace (Conditional Update)
  • // Replace value for a key (only if key exists)
boolean replaced = cache.replace(1, "Alice New");

// Compare-and-set: replace only if current value matches
boolean replaced = cache.replace(1, "Alice", "Alice Updated");

// Replace and return old value
String oldValue = cache.getAndReplace(1, "Alice Newest");
6. Atomic Entry Processors
  • Entry processors allow you to read-modify-write an entry atomically on the node that owns the data:
  • // Increment a counter atomically
cache.invoke(key, (entry, args) -> {
    int currentValue = entry.getValue();
    entry.setValue(currentValue + 1);
    return null;
});
  • This avoids the need to get(), modify, put() — which is not atomic and requires two network hops;
  • Entry processors execute on the primary node, reducing network traffic;
7. Async Operations
  • Every synchronous operation has an async counterpart that returns an IgniteFuture: 
    IgniteFuture<String> future = cache.getAsync(1);
future.listen(f -> System.out.println("Got: " + f.get()));
